name: MMKU-Bench
description:
🤗 Dataset 

To systematically evaluate multimodal knowledge updating in LMMs, we introduce MMKU-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that covers both updated knowledge and previously unknown knowledge. MMKU-Bench contains over 25k knowledge instances paired with more than 49k images, spanning 331 fine-grained types (including 156 updated types and 175 unknown types) across diverse visual knowledge domains.
For detailed usage and instructions, please refer to the GitHub page.

reputation: A recently introduced benchmark gaining attention for evaluating multimodal knowledge updating in large multimodal models; adoption is growing but still limited to specialized research groups.
